name: safepath-root
description: SafePath AI Monorepo Root - Single command setup and execution for all apps, AI backend server, and Postgres PostGIS database.

scripts.setup: npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run install:apps && npm run install:python
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix citizen_app/apps/citizen-mobile install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix municipality install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix admin_app install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix fleetoperator install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f citizen_app/docker-compose.yml up -d db || echo [DB] Postgres container skipped. Using persistent local DB.
scripts.db:status: python -c "from ai_model.db import db_manager; print('DB Status: Healthy. Records count:', db_manager.get_hazard_count())"
scripts.dev: concurrently --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow,green,red" -n "DB,AI-SERVER,CITIZEN,MUNICIPALITY,ADMIN,FLEET" "npm run db:up" "python ai_model/web_app.py" "npm --prefix citizen_app/apps/citizen-mobile start -- --port 8081" "npm --prefix municipality start -- --port 8082" "npm --prefix admin_app start -- --port 8083" "npm --prefix fleetoperator start -- --port 8084"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --prefix-colors "blue,yellow,green,red" -n "CITIZEN,MUNICIPALITY,ADMIN,FLEET" "npm --prefix citizen_app/apps/citizen-mobile start -- --port 8081" "npm --prefix municipality start -- --port 8082" "npm --prefix admin_app start -- --port 8083" "npm --prefix fleetoperator start -- --port 8084"
